verdict.rationale: Better Auth's own docs state that it hosts an official remote MCP server, which any MCP-capable client (Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, Open Code) can connect to for documentation search, examples, and setup help. That directly covers connecting an agent via an official MCP server. The separate MCP plugin is an OAuth building block for users' own MCP servers and is not credited here. missing for 10: connection/setup and tool-schema detail for the hosted server, tools beyond docs/setup help (e.g. operating on auth data), independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Better Auth hosts a remote MCP server that exposes documentation search, examples, and setup help to any MCP-capable client (Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, Open Code, and others).
